heading: INT. PARKING GARAGE - LEVEL P4 - NIGHT

units.text: INT. PARKING GARAGE - LEVEL P4 - NIGHT
Concrete.
Sodium lights.
A drip, somewhere.
A lone black sedan with its engine running.
AGENT VIKTORIA NASSAR, thirties, crouches behind a pillar with a pistol.
Ten yards away, her partner JUDE OKAFOR-BRANDT, forties, flattens against a van with a briefcase handcuffed to his wrist.
They exchange a look across the gap.
Two minutes.
units.name: JUDE

units.text: They're early.
units.name: VIKTORIA

units.text: Footsteps.
Heels on concrete.
Viktoria slides back a step and Jude drops low, the briefcase scraping against the van's fender.
A silhouette strides into the light from the stairwell, tall, bareheaded, arms loose.
The silhouette stops at the sedan and taps on the window.
The window rolls down.
Do you have it?
units.name: SILHOUETTE

units.text: A gloved hand passes out a thick envelope.
Viktoria's eyes narrow.
Jude lifts the briefcase an inch and then lowers it.
That's not our guy.
units.name: VIKTORIA

units.text: Whose guy is it?
units.name: JUDE

units.text: The envelope disappears under the silhouette's coat.
A new figure peels from the shadows behind them, a big man in a hood, MIKHAIL TOROSYAN, fifties, his pistol steady on Viktoria's pillar.
Out, please. Hands where I can see them.
units.name: MIKHAIL

units.text: Viktoria rises with her gun down.

Jude steps out from the van with the briefcase held high, wrist chained, as the silhouette turns at last and the light reveals the face of the sedan's driver, a woman with a scar through one eyebrow, who gives them a polite, regretful smile.

Then the sedan's engine roars, the headlights snap on, Viktoria dives left, Jude dives right, Mikhail fires, the first shot sparking off the pillar, and the sedan lurches forward and clips the van, spinning it into a column with a thunderous crunch.
Glass rains down.
Alarms scream through the garage.

In the confusion, Jude drags himself behind a stack of tires, Viktoria rolls to her feet and sprints for the stairwell, and Mikhail, bleeding from the scalp, fires at both of them without hitting either.
The sedan screeches up the ramp.
Viktoria hits the stairwell door with her shoulder, barges through, and gone.
Jude, alone and cuffed to his case, looks up at the swinging sodium lights.
Well. That went well.
units.name: JUDE
